Why it works

Access meets execution

CBFWA has relationships most agencies can't buy. Postgame has run NIL marketing and brand deals since the NCAA rule change in 2021.

More under one roof

Athletes get marketing, representation, brand deals and VIP access without juggling multiple teams.

Culture-driven talent

Athletes connected to music, entertainment and celebrity create campaigns that travel further than a standard NIL post.

Both sides aligned

Revenue share means CBFWA earns when Postgame closes, so every intro is worth working.

Postgame x CBFWA

How it works.

01CBFWA

CBFWA makes the intro to an athlete, celebrity, or brand.

02Postgame

Postgame handles contracting, marketing, and deal execution.

03CBFWA

CBFWA handles athlete management and concierge.

04Postgame

Postgame shares a percentage of revenue with CBFWA on every deal.

Postgame is the single point of contact for brands on contracts and payments, which keeps deals clean for athletes and partners. CBFWA stays the relationship lead with athletes and talent.
